funfact: Octopuses have three hearts, and their blood is blue!
Honey never spoils! Archaeologists have found 3,000-year-old honey in Egyptian tombs that is still perfectly safe to eat.
Bananas are naturally radioactive, but you would have to eat 10 million of them at once for it to affect you.
Sea otters hold hands while they sleep so they don't drift away from each other in the ocean currents.
A cloud might look light and fluffy, but an average cloud actually weighs as much as 100 elephants!
Butterflies taste their food using their feet instead of their mouths.
Sharks existed on Earth before trees were around!
Venus is the only planet in our solar system that spins in the opposite direction of most other planets.
Sloths can hold their breath underwater for up to 40 minutes, which is longer than dolphins can!
Cows have best friends and get stressed out when they are separated from them.
Sunlight takes about 8 minutes and 20 seconds to travel all the way from the Sun to Earth.
A group of flamingos is officially called a 'flamboyance'.
Wombats produce poop that is shaped like perfect little cubes so it doesn't roll away.
Polar bears actually have black skin underneath their thick white fur.
Your heart beats about 100,000 times in a single day.
Pineapples take almost two years to grow into a full fruit!
Dolphins give each other unique names using special whistle sounds.
There are more trees on planet Earth than there are stars in the Milky Way galaxy.
A bolt of lightning is about five times hotter than the surface of the Sun!
Frogs can absorb water through their skin, so they never have to drink water with their mouths.
Starfish don't have brains or blood, and they can regrow an arm if they lose one.
Saturn is so lightweight relative to its size that if you found a bathtub big enough, the planet would float in water!
Cats spend about 70 percent of their lives sleeping.
Hummingbirds are the only birds in the world that can fly backward.
Snails can take naps that last up to three full years!
Rats giggle when you tickle them, but their giggles are too high-pitched for human ears to hear.
Avocados, tomatoes, and cucumbers are technically all fruits, not vegetables.
A day on the planet Mercury lasts longer than a whole year on Mercury!
Ants are so strong that they can carry objects up to 50 times their own body weight.
Flamingos are naturally white or gray, but turn pink because of the tiny shrimp and algae they eat.
Hot water actually freezes faster than cold water under specific conditions—this is called the Mpemba effect.
A group of owls is called a 'parliament'.
Human teeth are just as strong as shark teeth!

Elephants are the only land mammals that cannot jump.
The blue whale's tongue weighs as much as an entire adult elephant.
Crows are super smart and can remember individual human faces for years.
Astronauts say that space actually smells like burnt steak and hot metal.
A newborn kangaroo is so small when it's born that it is about the size of a single lima bean.
Your nose and ears never stop growing your entire life!
Bees can fly higher than Mount Everest if they need to!
Apples float in water because 25 percent of their total volume is just trapped air.
Male seahorses are the ones that carry and give birth to the babies, not the females!
The Great Red Spot on Jupiter is a giant storm that has been spinning for hundreds of years and is bigger than planet Earth.
Giraffes have dark purple-black tongues that can be 20 inches long to keep them from getting sunburned while eating.
You produce enough saliva in your mouth over a single year to fill up two whole bathtub tubs.
A group of hippos hanging out together in the water is called a 'bloat'.
Reindeer eyes change color depending on the season—they are gold in the summer and turn deep blue in the dark winter.
Strawberries are the only fruit in the world that wear all of their seeds on the outside.
There is a type of jellyfish called the Immortal Jellyfish that can turn back into a baby whenever it gets old or injured!
